date.as_written: śrīśāke 173 samvat 1867 sāla miti śrāvaṇa vadi vāre caṃdra

place.as_written: śrīvakmati gaṃgā nikaṭe śrīpasupati chetreḥ kāṃtipurāgrāmasthāneḥ

notes: The Śāka year is given incompletely as 173 (likely intending Śāke 1732, corresponding to VS 1867). The tithi is omitted before 'vāre caṃdra'.
